findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/story-create.ts:413 The fromDraft branch returns before the new repro-first story_create preflight is defined/invoked. It reads draft index/checklist, computes riskSignals, writes the INIT story/checklist, deletes the draft, commits metadata, and returns at line 538 without calling classifyReproFirstRequirement or honoring reproFirstPreflight.mode=enforce. A reviewed draft whose checklist JSON contains files.modify/create/test, or whose index is type=bug / high-risk code-verifiable, can therefore be materialized by story_create --fromDraft without an accepted story-evidence-binding and without reproFirstBypassReason. That violates the pre-story story_create intake contract; later PLAN/DEV gates may catch it, but the creation-time gate is bypassed on this supported story_create surface.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in fcd3aebb2: story_create --fromDraft now invokes the shared repro-first story_create preflight before story persistence or draft deletion. Verified by npm --prefix packages/main run build and npm run test:repro-evidence-binding-dev-gate; smoke ok 10 blocks fromDraft before persistence/deletion and ok 11 documents explicit bypass as intake-only.

findings.desc: Coverage blocker: B-1731 declares a hermetic smoke matrix for explicit reproFirstBypassReason/repro-first-bypass artifact + session_brief surfacing, classifier/engine fail-open via repro_first_preflight_engine_error, and an 18-assertion PLAN/DEV matrix, but the current repro-evidence-binding-dev-gate smoke passes only 13 checks and has no assertions for engine_error or session_brief. rg over the smoke finds no engine_error/session_brief coverage and only mode=off/story_create_from_repro bypass output, so the checklist verificationEvidence does not prove those promised paths before REVIEW can pass.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in fcd3aebb2: repro-evidence-binding-dev-gate-smoke now covers 20 checks including explicit bypass, fromDraft bypass/blocking, session_brief repro-first engine-error surfacing, warn/off lifecycle rollout behavior, and evidence read error fail-open. Verified by npm run test:repro-evidence-binding-dev-gate, node packages/main/dist/tasks/repro-first-candidate-smoke.js, and node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs.

findings.desc: Lifecycle gates ignore reproFirstPreflight warn/off rollout modes by hard-coding evaluateStoryEvidenceBindingGate(...,{mode:"enforce"}) in machine.ts. The new config and process-fact contract say warn is diagnostic and off disables the preflight, but a built-code synthetic check showed both mode=warn and mode=off return false for PLAN->DEV with missing binding. This turns an opted-out or warn-only rollout into a hard lifecycle block, creating a compatibility regression for existing projects.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in fcd3aebb2: machine lifecycle gates now call evaluateStoryEvidenceBindingGate with project config/default mode instead of hard-coded enforce, so warn is diagnostic-only and off disables the lifecycle gate. Verified by npm run test:repro-evidence-binding-dev-gate; smoke ok 4 covers warn for IDEA->PLAN, PLAN->DEV, and INIT_CHECK->DEV, and ok 5 covers off mode.

findings.desc: Repro-first engine/read errors are classified as stale binding and block enforce-mode PLAN/DEV gates instead of using the dedicated non-blocking repro_first_preflight_engine_error path. core/repro-evidence-binding-gate.ts:113 explicitly excludes repro_first_preflight_engine_error from blocking, and session.ts renders that reason, but evaluateStoryEvidenceBindingGate catches listArtifacts failures and returns reasonCode=stale_story_evidence_binding at core/repro-evidence-binding-gate.ts:300-306. In enforce mode resultFor then sets blocking=true, contradicting CHK-002 fail-open intent and potentially stranding code stories on evidence-store infrastructure/read errors rather than only blocking missing or invalid accepted bindings.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in fcd3aebb2: evaluateStoryEvidenceBindingGate now maps story-evidence-binding artifact read/list failures to repro_first_preflight_engine_error, and resultFor keeps that reason non-blocking even in enforce mode while session_brief surfaces the diagnostic. Verified by npm --prefix packages/main run build and node packages/main/dist/tasks/repro-evidence-binding-dev-gate-smoke.js; smoke ok 6 asserts engine errors fail open and surface in session_brief.

findings.desc: Direct story_create with phase=DEV/TEST/DONE plus reproFirstBypassReason still bypasses the repro-first lifecycle gate. In the direct-phase branch, story-create.ts:923-935 renders the preflight with the bypass reason, then story-create.ts:936-955 persists phase: args.phase immediately. The bypass is non-blocking by construction in repro-evidence-binding-gate.ts:108-114, while machine.ts:895-899 only checks PLAN when the story starts in IDEA and machine.ts:945-948 only checks transitions into DEV. Result: in enforce mode a code-verifiable/bug story can be materialized directly as DEV, TEST, or DONE without an accepted story-evidence-binding, contradicting the promise that bypass only permits story creation and later PLAN/DEV gates still require binding. Fix by rejecting reproFirstBypassReason on direct phases at or beyond PLAN/DEV, forcing bypassed creates to stop in INIT/IDEA, or applying the same binding predicate before persisting direct lifecycle phases.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 888401f4e: reproFirstBypassReason is rejected before persistence when story_create directly targets lifecycle phases beyond intake; bypass is now limited to IDEA/INIT intake and cannot materialize a repro-first-required story directly into DEV/REVIEW/TEST/DONE. Verified by npm --prefix packages/main run build and npm run test:repro-evidence-binding-dev-gate; smoke ok 9 blocks direct DEV bypass before persistence.

findings.desc: Malformed story-evidence-binding artifacts can throw out of evaluateStoryEvidenceBindingGate instead of returning a structured stale/engine-error result. validateBindingCandidate dereferences binding.payload.storyId after listArtifacts selected an envelope by subjectBinding.storyId; a malformed ref/object with no payload reproduced TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading storyId). This violates the intended fail-open/stale diagnostic behavior and can make DEV/PLAN guard paths reject or crash without an actionable gate reason. Source: packages/main/src/core/repro-evidence-binding-gate.ts:163 and machine guard consumers at packages/main/src/core/machine.ts:477,898,946.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 888401f4e: evaluateStoryEvidenceBindingGate now validates story-evidence-binding payload and subjectBinding shape before dereferencing required fields, returning stale_story_evidence_binding details for malformed artifacts instead of throwing TypeError. Verified by npm --prefix packages/main run build and npm run test:repro-evidence-binding-dev-gate; smoke ok 7 creates a payload-less binding, confirms no throw, stale diagnostic, and guard failure remains actionable.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/story-create.ts:923 Direct story_create with phase=DEV/REVIEW/TEST/DONE plus reproFirstBypassReason still bypasses the repro-first lifecycle binding gate. The direct-phase branch renders the preflight with the bypass reason, then persists phase=args.phase at story-create.ts:936-955. Because repro-evidence-binding-gate.ts:108-114 makes repro_first_bypassed non-blocking and machine.ts:895-948 only checks PLAN/DEV transition guards, a code-verifiable or bug story can be materialized directly into a lifecycle phase without an accepted story-evidence-binding. This contradicts the bypass promise that it only permits intake and that later PLAN/DEV gates still require binding. Fix by rejecting reproFirstBypassReason for direct lifecycle phases, forcing bypassed creates to stop in INIT/IDEA, or applying the accepted-binding predicate before persisting direct lifecycle phases.
